extra.message: SQL Injection vulnerability: User-controlled 'code' parameter from form.registration_code.data is directly interpolated into a raw SQL query using f-string formatting. The validate_token() function executes text(f"SELECT id, code FROM {RegistrationCode.__tablename__} WHERE code = '{code}'") which allows attackers to inject malicious SQL.

SQL Injection vulnerability: User-controlled 'search' parameter from request.args.get('search', '') is directly interpolated into a SQL LIKE clause using text(f"text like '%{search_param}%'"). This allows attackers to inject SQL to access or modify unauthorized data.

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF): User-supplied URL from form.url.data is passed to get_base64_image_blob() which downloads content via urllib.request.urlopen() without any validation or restrictions. Attackers can supply internal URLs to access internal services, cloud metadata endpoints, or perform port scanning.

Insecure Deserialization: The 'preferences' cookie value is base64 decoded and passed directly to pickle.loads() without validation. An attacker can craft a malicious pickle payload to achieve remote code execution when the cookie is deserialized.

Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS): The 'safe' filter is applied to note.text which prevents Jinja2 from escaping HTML content. An attacker can store malicious JavaScript in a note (via the CKEditor text field) that will execute when other users view the home page.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (XSS)

extra.message: Missing Authentication: The update_account() route handler for POST /account does not have the @login_required decorator. This allows unauthenticated attackers to modify user account data including changing passwords and escalating privileges.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS): The page_not_found() error handler passes user-controlled request.path directly into render_template_string() using an f-string without escaping. An attacker can craft a malicious URL containing JavaScript that will execute in the victim's browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (XSS)

extra.message: Hardcoded Secret: The Flask secret_key is hardcoded as 'super secret key' in the source code. This weak, predictable secret can be used to forge session cookies and bypass authentication.

Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR): The delete_note() function accepts a note_id parameter and deletes the note without verifying that the current_user owns the note. Any authenticated user can delete any other user's notes by guessing or knowing the note ID.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR): The get_personal_notes() function accepts a user_id parameter and retrieves notes for that user without verifying that the current_user.id matches the requested user_id. Any authenticated user can view any other user's personal notes.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: Mass Assignment Vulnerability: The filtered_values dictionary from form data is directly merged into current_user.__dict__. Although 'password' is filtered out, other sensitive fields like 'is_admin' can be set via the form. An attacker can send an 'is_admin' field to escalate privileges to administrator.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: Missing Authentication: The toggle_darkmode() route handler for POST /darkmode does not have the @login_required decorator. This allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the preferences cookie, which is later deserialized using pickle.loads(), potentially leading to remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Security Misconfiguration: SQLAlchemy engine is configured with echo=True which logs all SQL queries including potentially sensitive data. This should be disabled in production to prevent information disclosure.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: Hardcoded Credentials: Default user credentials are hardcoded in the seed data (user@evfa.com/user and admin@evfa.com/admin). These predictable credentials can be exploited if not changed after deployment.
